customManagers.description: The clang22 pin: a Mavergreen/clang-22 release tag; it compiles and links the plug-in and its updater.
The lzfse pin: a commit on lzfse/lzfse's master, compiled into the plug-in.
The xz-embedded pin: a commit on tukaani-project/xz-embedded's master, compiled into the plug-in.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so the build fails at the fetch until components/clang22/linux-sha256 names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/clang22/linux-sha256 with the `linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <tag> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/clang22/linux-sha256`.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves a codec's commit but cannot write the SHA-256 of GitHub's tarball of it, so the build fails at the fetch until components/<codec>/sha256 holds it.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, write the SHA-256 of GitHub's tarball of the new commit to components/{{depName}}/sha256: `curl -sL {{packageName}}/archive/<commit>.tar.gz | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1`. The fetch prints the SHA-256 it got when it refuses, so the failing build names it too.
